Captain Ramirez: "They were exhausted because they had been building sandbag barriers nonstop for twelve hours."
Commander Scott: "How long had the meteorology station been tracking the hurricane before it made landfall?"
Captain Ramirez: "Our radar operators had been monitoring atmospheric pressure drops for three straight days."
questions.question: Dựa vào đoạn đối thoại trên, thông tin nào sau đây là CHÍNH XÁC về nội dung câu nói của Commander Scott?
options: Commander Scott muốn mượn tiền để mua vé máy bay gấp.
Commander Scott từ chối trả lời và yêu cầu hủy cuộc hẹn.
Commander Scott chia sẻ thông tin: "Chào buổi sáng cả đội. Tại sao các tình nguyện viên cứu hộ khẩn cấp lại kiệt sức đến vậy khi cơn bão cuối cùng cũng qua đi?"
Commander Scott phàn nàn rằng thời tiết hôm nay quá xấu.

Commander Scott: "The ground was completely waterlogged. Had it been raining heavily throughout the previous night?"
Captain Ramirez: "Yes, it had been pouring torrential rain since midnight before the river embankments breached."
Commander Scott: "The generator engines were overheating because they had been running at maximum capacity without pause."
Captain Ramirez: "Our paramedics had been treating injured residents before mobile hospital tents were set up."
